title: Croatian Meat Kebabs with Crispy Onions
description: A hearty and flavorful meal of meat kebabs with crispy onions, inspired by Croatian cuisine. Serve with your favorite sides for a satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: 1 lb boneless beef or pork shoulder

instructions: Cut the beef or pork into 1-inch cubes and season with salt, pepper, and paprika.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, buttermilk, and a pinch of salt. Add the cubed meat and mix until the meat is well coated.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the meat and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the meat to a plate and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the sliced onions and cook until they are crispy and golden brown, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the cooked meat back into the skillet with the crispy onions and stir to combine.
Serve the meat kebabs hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or dill if desired.
Optional: Serve with your favorite sides, such as mashed potatoes, roasted vegetables, or a simple salad.
